panels.title: Scrape availability (1 = reachable, not application health)
HTTP metric present (0 = absent / app upgrade needed)
panels.description: Absence may mean no completed request yet or backend still emits legacy metric. Generate a smoke request and check version.

targets.expr: count by (service) (http_server_request_duration_seconds_count{service=~"$service",job="application"}) > bool 0 or on(service) (0 * min by (service) (up{job="application",service=~"$service"}))

panels.title: Request rate
panels.description: Application requests including 404; excludes /metrics at source and health probes here. Missing target yields no data, not zero.

panels.title: 5xx ratio (no traffic = no data)
panels.description: Zero errors is shown only with positive request rate. Requires a reachable target. No data does not mean healthy.

targets.expr: 100 * ((sum by (service) (rate(http_server_request_duration_seconds_count{service=~"$service",job="application",route!~"/health/.*",status_class="5xx"}[$__rate_interval])) or on(service) (0 * sum by (service) (rate(http_server_request_duration_seconds_count{service=~"$service",job="application",route!~"/health/.*"}[$__rate_interval])))) / (sum by (service) (rate(http_server_request_duration_seconds_count{service=~"$service",job="application",route!~"/health/.*"}[$__rate_interval])) > 0)) and on(service) (min by (service) (up{job="application",service=~"$service"}) == 1)

panels.title: p50 request duration
panels.description: Classic histogram estimate. No completed traffic or fewer than two scrape samples gives no data. Long-lived SSE is recorded on completion.

targets.expr: histogram_quantile(0.5, sum by (le, service) (rate(http_server_request_duration_seconds_bucket{service=~"$service",job="application",route!~"/health/.*"}[$__rate_interval]))) and on(service) (sum by (service) (rate(http_server_request_duration_seconds_count{service=~"$service",job="application",route!~"/health/.*"}[$__rate_interval])) > 0) and on(service) (min by (service) (up{job="application",service=~"$service"}) == 1)
